"""Main-only new cache512 q, binding original actual long q without rewriting proofs.

--manifest path/SHA: main_reviewed=true and pins base_qualification, controller_cpu,
controller_review, capacity_receipt. Source review is Main's NEW exact-seven-file
review receipt, not a SourceOnly implementation report or runtime qualification.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from cache_support import B, P, CacheRun, caps, closed, exact, load, need, packet, pin, sha


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--manifest', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--manifest-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--main-reviewed', action='store_true', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    common, policy, pins = packet()
    manifest = load(exact(dict(path=str(args.manifest), sha256=args.manifest_sha256)))
    need(manifest.get('main_reviewed') is True, 'actual Main reviewed input pins')
    basepath = exact(manifest['base_qualification'])
    q = load(basepath)
    need(q['status'] == 'passed' and q['main_reviewed'] is True and q['binaries'] == policy.BINARIES and
         q['production_source_pins'] == load(P / 'production-source-pins.json')['source_pins'], 'unchanged original actual official q')
    old = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-long-controller-source-v1'
    need(set(q['controller_source_pins']) == set(pins) and
         all(sha(old / name) == digest for name, digest in q['controller_source_pins'].items()), 'actual original long closure')
    cpu = closed(load(exact(manifest['controller_cpu'])))
    review = load(exact(manifest['controller_review']))
    for value in (cpu, review):
        need(value.get('main_reviewed') is True and value.get('gpu_executed') is False and
             value.get('controller_source_pins') == pins, 'new CPU/full-read review binds exact cache code')
    need(review.get('passed') is True and review.get('complete') is True and review.get('active') is False and
         not review.get('error'), 'actual Main source review, not runtime PASS')
    capacity = closed(load(exact(manifest['capacity_receipt'])))
    observed = caps(capacity['caps_stdout'])
    need(all(capacity.get(key) == value for key, value in observed.items()),
         'actual CAPS fields, independent native0xe20c and limits match wrapper exactly')
    run = CacheRun(args.output, 360)
    error = None
    try:
        code = "from pathlib import Path;from common import admit,load;from policy import HERE;import sys;admit(load(Path(sys.argv[1])),'official',load(HERE/'production-source-pins.json'));print('PASS original actual admission; no owner import or model launch')"
        run.run('original-long-admission', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', '-c', code, str(basepath)], cwd=old,
                wall=120, cpu=180)
        run.r['original_qualification'] = manifest['base_qualification']
        q['controller_source_pins'] = pins
        q['receipts']['controller_cpu'] = manifest['controller_cpu']
        q['receipts']['controller_review'] = manifest['controller_review']
        q['cache_capacity_receipt'] = manifest['capacity_receipt']
        common.admit(q, 'official', load(P / 'production-source-pins.json'))
        target = args.output / 'qualification.json'
        target.write_text(json.dumps(q, indent=2) + '\n')
        run.run('new-cache512-admission', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', '-c', code, str(target)],
                cwd=P, wall=120, cpu=180)
        run.r.update(qualification=pin(target), controller_source_pins=pins,
            current_cache512_model_inference_tested=False, capacity_receipt=manifest['capacity_receipt'],
            scope='Fresh controller/source/property admission only; original build/provider/model identity proofs preserved', complete=True)
    except BaseException as caught:
        error = caught
    code = run.finish(error)
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=run.r['passed'], error=run.r.get('error'), qualification=run.r.get('qualification'))))
    return code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
